about_the_role: Lumen Interfaces builds design-system-driven web applications for B2B SaaS clients. You will spend most of your time in React, turning a component library into real product screens.
responsibilities: Implement screens in React using an existing component library and design tokens.
Wire up application state and handle asynchronous data fetching from REST APIs.
Fix cross-browser and responsive layout defects reported by QA.
Contribute reusable components back to the shared design system.
Keep interfaces fast by avoiding unnecessary re-renders and oversized bundles.
required_skills: Confident JavaScript, including array methods, destructuring and modules.
React fundamentals: components, props, hooks and conditional rendering.
HTML semantics and CSS layout using flexbox and grid.
Responsive Design across mobile, tablet and desktop breakpoints.
Ability to call REST APIs with fetch and render loading and error states.
Git basics including branching, committing and resolving merge conflicts.
preferred_skills: Tailwind CSS or another utility-first CSS framework.
Experience with Vite as a build tool.
Understanding of Web Accessibility and semantic markup.
Familiarity with Figma for reading design specifications.
Any experience with automated frontend Testing.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a demonstrable equivalent portfolio.
At least two React projects you can walk through in an interview.
